basics.name: Snoopy
basics.label: Author / World War I Flying Ace / World Icon
basics.summary: World-famous beagle with deep experience in literary production, aerial operations, fine art acquisition, and root beer evaluation. Known for maintaining multiple high-performing personal brands, including Joe Cool and the World War I Flying Ace. Operates primarily from a rooftop office with a strong emphasis on naps, imagination, and strategic timing before supper.

references.reference: A loyal companion, strong listener, and unusually productive novelist considering the lack of opposable thumbs.
references.name: Charlie Brown, Owner / Long-Term Collaborator

references.reference: Excellent under pressure, though occasionally too committed to aerial combat simulations to answer basic questions.
references.name: Woodstock, Close Associate and Mission Support

references.reference: Shows confidence, stage presence, and a complete indifference to conventional criticism.
references.name: Lucy van Pelt, Independent Personality Analyst

awards.title: World's Most Famous Beagle
awards.summary: Maintained iconic multi-generational cultural relevance through style, imagination, and excellent silhouette design.

volunteer.summary: Provides companionship, comic relief, and occasional dramatic framing for nearby humans and birds.
highlights: Supported Charlie Brown through repeated emotional turbulence.
